_comment: Hand-maintained. One entry per protocol version we track on Ethereum mainnet: sources file a version separately, so we collect it separately. `group` only nests rows on the dashboard — data is never merged across versions. The frontend imports this file at build time; adding a protocol means an entry here plus a line in the mappings of the adapters that cover it. A protocol no adapter maps is fine: its row simply shows no data.
